items.title: St Helens appoint Australia boss Walters as head coach
items.summary: St Helens have announced the appointment of Australia boss Kevin Walters as their head coach on a three-year deal from the start of the 2027 Super League season.

items.title: Aguero and Shearer star in best opening-round debuts
items.summary: BBC Sport takes a look at some of the Premier League's greatest opening-day debuts, including Alan Shearer's Blackburn blinder and Michu's Swansea screamers.

items.title: Premier League predictions 2026-27: BBC Sport pundits pick their top four
items.summary: We ask 26 BBC Sport football pundits to predict who will win the 2026-27 Premier League title, and which clubs will finish in the top four.
